reference.notes: The transcript is a compilation: Sagos's owners (Kreuzberg) review a square-spit döner place in Mitte named only in speech as 'Beef 73 Haus' (spelling uncertain), then Sagos's own promotional clips; I attributed the unnamed 1-cent/renovation clip to Sagos as the speaker's own venue, which is a judgement call. Marked promotional because most of the post is the venue advertising its own deals; the second branch is unnamed so not a place.

match.note: Beef 73 Haus is a Döner shop in Mitte; no candidate has that name (Beef Grill Club is a steak house, Das Cafe Haus is a cafe).
Sagos is a Döner shop; Spagos is a gastropub at Alexanderplatz, and no candidate matches the name or the street.
